purpose: Use globally allocated SDL object IDs for AROS lowlevel joysticks; prevent collisions with virtual and other joystick backends.
verification: Native x86_64 AROS ABIv1: identical production-decoder test linked against original SDL reports two duplicate-ID failures (RC1); patched SDL passes all checks (RC0), including keyboard directions/fire charge/release, independent two-virtual-pad state and detach. Ambient lowlevel joystick remains enumerated, but is disconnected from game slots via the real removal-event handler. Original unisolated probe recorded ten setter/state failures. Physical pads and full two-human match remain unverified.
upstream_resolution: Equivalent fix already present upstream before this local patch; no submission needed. Retain for the older pinned backend until dependency update is verified.
